issue_context.title: Nibe F730 Climate System S1 not shown
issue_context.body: ### The problem Hi all, f730 and I guess also some other heat pumps do not support cooling, if so the Climate System is not setup/shown. The log contains: ``` 2024-03-31 00:55:01.674 DEBUG (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.nibe_heatpump] Skipping climate: s1 due to Coil with address 48785 not found 2024-03-31 00:55:01.674 DEBUG (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.nibe_heatpump] Skipping climate: s2 due to Coil with address 48784 not found 2024-03-31 00:55:01.674 DEBUG (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.nibe_heatpump] Skipping climate: s3 due to Coil with address 48783 not found 2024-03-31 00:55:01.674 DEBUG (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.nibe_heatpump] Skipping climate: s4 due to Coil with address 48782 not found 2024-03-31 00:55:08.616 DEBUG (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.nibe_heatpump] Skipping seeded coil: 40033 ``` The UI shows only hot water: After patching this: [f730_noclimate.patch](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/files/14817702/f730_noclimate.patch) The UI will show the Climate but will not allow to set the cooling mode: ### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue? core-2024.3.1 ### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core? _No response_ ### What type of installation are you running? Home Assistant OS ### Integration causing the issue Nibe Heat Pump ### Link to integration documentation on our website https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/nibe_heatpump ### Diagnostics information [home-assistant_nibe_heatpump_2024-03-31T21-53-24.969Z.log](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/files/14817730/home-assistant_nibe_heatpump_2024-03-31T21-53-24.969Z.log) ### Example YAML snippet _No response_ ### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us? _No response_ ### Additional information _No response_
